note: Shape is consistent with clients/shared/20-phase3c2d-consumption-contracts/CONSUMPTION_PROJECTION_REGISTRY.json (worktree nexus-consumption-3c2d). Every new_projections entry follows that file's existing object shape exactly (projection_name, consumers, purpose, source_publication, build_gate, partial_data_behavior, key_fields, required_metadata). amend_projections entries name the existing projection_name and list only the delta. investigate_before_register entries are populated tables that must NOT be registered as-is until an open question is resolved -- registering them today would encode contract drift (SD-04 pattern) rather than fix it.

new_projections.purpose: external cohort comparison statistics for named tenant metrics, structurally separate from tenant's own accepted facts
new_projections.build_gate: optional; a metric may render without a benchmark row, never the reverse
new_projections.partial_data_behavior: a benchmark row without a matching tenant metric_observation_v1 value must not render a tenant position on the bar

new_projections.purpose: cross-carrier/cross-industry observed patterns explicitly linked to tenant evidence gaps that would confirm or deny applicability
new_projections.partial_data_behavior: a pattern's applicability_rating may not render without at least one real linked_gap_id resolving in consumption.evidence_gap_v1

new_projections.purpose: consumption-safe, Layer-3-derived summary of source material this tenant's knowledge is built from -- exposes what source_registry.source (Layer 1/2) cannot lawfully be read directly by any product
new_projections.build_gate: required before the Brief 'what it stands on' section or the Evidence 'where it came from' section may render
new_projections.partial_data_behavior: a source with state=awaited renders with received_date=null and availability_state=not_loaded, never omitted from the list

new_projections.purpose: infrastructure/cloud platform inventory -- the single largest source family in the corpus (10,000 rows) with zero current downstream representation
new_projections.build_gate: required before Explore Infrastructure and cloud table renders
new_projections.partial_data_behavior: no zero substitution for missing owner/recovery_objective
blocks_matrix_rows: Explore / Infrastructure and cloud inventory table

new_projections.purpose: accepted data-product inventory with stewardship, certification and sensitivity -- registers a table that is ALREADY POPULATED (6,580 rows) and already read by the shipped Cube model, but has never been declared in the governed registry
new_projections.build_gate: required before Explore Data products table or Cube DataAnalyticsEstate.data_product_count render
new_projections.partial_data_behavior: no zero substitution for missing steward/certification
new_projections.special_condition: Before this entry is accepted as-is, CANONICAL_TO_PUBLICATION_MAPPING.xlsx's existing confirmed mapping of knowledge.data_product -> domain_summary_v1 (implying ~1,250 source rows) must be reconciled against this table's actual 6,580 rows -- either the mapping doc is corrected with a documented 5.26x transformation, or this object is redefined at the grain the 6,580 rows actually represent. Do not register blindly against the live row count without resolving this discrepancy; that would just move the contract-drift problem rather than close it.

new_projections.purpose: decision-level readiness rollup once the canonical Decision object exists in Layer 3
new_projections.source_publication: publication.decision_publication_v1 (new; depends on canonical Decision object being ratified first)
new_projections.build_gate: required after the canonical Decision object type is ratified in the Enterprise Information Architecture -- this projection cannot be built before that
new_projections.partial_data_behavior: readiness_state is always derived, never hand-set; a decision whose inputs are unresolved renders 'Not assessed', never a default value
new_projections.prerequisite: Canonical Decision object (Layer 3) must be ratified before this projection is meaningful; do not build the projection first and backfill the object later.

new_projections.purpose: tracked disagreements between two accepted sources, with owner and downstream effect
new_projections.source_publication: publication.contradiction_publication_v1 (new; depends on canonical Contradiction object being ratified first)
new_projections.build_gate: required after the canonical Contradiction object type is ratified
new_projections.partial_data_behavior: both conflicting statements must independently resolve to authority_state=accepted before a contradiction may be published; a stale-vs-current mismatch is not a contradiction
new_projections.prerequisite: Canonical Contradiction object (Layer 3) must be ratified first.
new_projections.live_example_of_the_defect_this_closes: SD-02 (service_tower disagrees between an application row and its own linked contract row for the same contract_id) is a real, already-found instance of exactly the shape this object needs to track.

investigate_before_register.required_before_registration: Prove distinct source lineage (register with a real source_publication), OR confirm it is a copy and retire it, redirecting Cube TechnologyEstate.legacy_platform_count to application_inventory_v1 directly.
